# DEXA Bone Density Test Result

> A UK NHS–aligned **DEXA / DXA (dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry) bone-density result (report)** that a reporting clinician completes after a DEXA examination has been performed. It is the **result/report counterpart** to *DEXA Bone Density Test Request* (a referral): where the request captures why a scan should be done, this form records what the scan **found** and a structured **interpretation**.
